name: DTF Visual System V1
brandPositioning: premium botanical science x genetics laboratory x independent game studio

typography.display: condensed uppercase display face with narrow fallback
rules: small uppercase utility labels only when useful

geometry.buttons: compact rectangular controls; primary moss-green, secondary transparent dark

imagery.genetics: high-detail plant and strain photography/card art
imagery.education: scientific diagrams, full-sheet infographics, botanical macro imagery
imagery.tools: real interface screenshots, measurement examples, plant records
imagery.games: dedicated cinematic key art per game with code-native UI
rules: use strong single visual moments instead of decorative clutter
preserve correct aspect ratios and mobile crops

mobileFirstPriorities: horizontal rails only where browse behavior benefits

implementationRules: reusable tokens and components before page-specific styling
do not alter independent game runtime logic while styling wrappers
one source of truth for navigation and public game counts
all legacy top-level pages migrate to the same shell
verify desktop and mobile before promotion to main
